name: immich-plugin-no-exif-date-fallback
title: No-EXIF Date Fallback
description: Photos received through WhatsApp, Messenger or Instagram arrive with their EXIF stripped entirely, and the Immich mobile app then dates them 1970-01-01. This falls back to the file's own modification date — the date your phone displays — which survives the upload intact.
author: Francois Chaussin

methods.name: fallbackToFileDate
methods.title: Fall back to the file's date when EXIF has none
methods.description: When an asset is dated at or near the Unix epoch, because the file carried no EXIF date and the uploading client sent an empty capture date, replace it with the file's modification date.

thresholdYear.title: Treat dates before this year as broken
thresholdYear.description: Any asset dated before 1 January of this year is considered mis-dated. Photography predating this is not expected in a phone backup.

templates.name: immich-plugin-no-exif-date-fallback
templates.title: Fix photos dated 1 January 1970
templates.description: Runs after metadata extraction. For WhatsApp, Messenger and Instagram photos that arrive with no EXIF date, uses the date the file itself carries instead of the epoch.
